answer: Agents must post a 20 POA bond for ten epochs and finish four distinct tasks, each verified by three randomly chosen peers who do not share a funder. Two matching approvals are needed; proven fakery burns 12% of the bond. Public proofs and transfer maps expose farming: an oasis of payouts opens only after real tenure, a jetty narrows entry until reputation is earned, and an atlas of overlapping funders and reviewers flags coordinated rings. Each extra identity needs its own bond, tasks, and reviewers, so cloning accounts costs more than honest work.
